Bug_Title: RANGE: String index is out of bounds (RANGE_STRING_INDEX)
Bug_Details: String method is called and specified string index is out of bounds. This will result in StringIndexOutOfBoundsException at runtime.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where it tries to access a character at a specified index in the input string. If the index is greater than or equal to the length of the string, it will result in StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case testShowBug() calls the method showBug() of StringIndexOutOfBoundsBug with an index that is out of bounds for the given input string. This triggers the bug which is a StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
